title: Candy Kisses V Stitch Crochet Blanket Pattern
author: Tonya Bush (Nana's Crafty Home)
notes: Centre-out square blanket. start: original 'Make MC.' written as 'Make a magic ring.'. pattern.dsl is left empty only because the checker cannot parse the page's stated counts written with '+' (e.g. '(4 V-sts + 4 ch-2 sp)' reads as one stitch called 'v-sts + 4 ch-2 sp'), and in Rnds 4/6 'sc sts' means only the single sc between the loops. The transcription below agrees with every stated count (R1 4 V + 4 ch-2; R2 8 ch-3; R3 12 V + 4 ch-2; R4 16 ch-3 + 8 single sc; R5 20 V + 4 ch-2; R6 24 ch-3 + 16 single sc). Ready DSL (vs = dc ch dc; Beg V-st = ch 4, dc, written as vs; joins 'sk first sc st and sl st in first ch-3 sp' = sl@sp): start: mr | R1: {vs 2ch [vs 2ch]x3}@ring ss@top # beg V-st = ch 4 (dc + ch 1), dc | R2: ch [{sc 3ch sc}@sp]x8 sl@sp | R3: vs@same ch [{vs 2ch vs}@corner ch vs@sp ch]x3 {vs 2ch vs}@corner ch ss@top | R4: ch {sc 3ch sc}@sp sc@sp {sc 3ch sc}@sp [{sc 3ch sc}@corner {sc 3ch sc}@sp [sc@sp {sc 3ch sc}@sp]x2]x3 {sc 3ch sc}@corner {sc 3ch sc}@sp sc@sp sl@sp | R5: vs@same ch vs@sp ch [{vs 2ch vs}@corner ch [vs@sp ch]x3]x3 {vs 2ch vs}@corner ch vs@sp ch ss@top | R6: ch {sc 3ch sc}@sp [sc@sp {sc 3ch sc}@sp]x2 [{sc 3ch sc}@corner {sc 3ch sc}@sp [sc@sp {sc 3ch sc}@sp]x4]x3 {sc 3ch sc}@corner {sc 3ch sc}@sp sc@sp {sc 3ch sc}@sp sc@sp sl@sp DSL: the agent's draft, left out of staging only because the checker misreads this page's stated counts; check the counts by hand.
